content.short: Tokenization platform incubated by Standard Chartered for issuing bond and fund tokens.
content.description: Libeara helps issuers structure and launch digital-native fund and bond tokens on public blockchains while keeping legal enforceability and governance intact. Incubated by Standard Chartered's SC Ventures and based in Singapore, it has tokenized more than $1 billion in assets across networks including Ethereum and Arbitrum, and received in-principle approval for a capital markets licence from MAS.
content.meta: Libeara, from Standard Chartered's SC Ventures, tokenizes bonds and funds on public chains, with $1B+ issued.
